work: Separated the Sentosa Bungy jump from the combined Skypark Sentosa clue. Official Park and StandaloneAttraction searches for Skypark Sentosa, AJ Hackett Sentosa and Sentosa Bungy found no counterpart. Created the fixed jump as a standalone with eight descriptions, official SGD 99 individual fare and two access conditions. Imported an exact CC BY-SA 3.0 photograph showing a person suspended from the Sentosa Bungy tower, verified eight public routes and the image binary HTTP 200, and published Facebook.
qualification: Skypark Sentosa operates multiple separately sold fixed activities. This entry covers only Bungy; Giant Swing and Skyslides remain separate candidates because the Bungy image must not represent them.
